expert_context.star_purpose: The source-invariant, self-describing, content-addressed star schema: values/columns dimension pairs for the source, run, timeframe, and invoice_lines groups, plus the invoice_lines fact table and the context registry (D-19): the address of meaning, one row per schema key. Every source lands in the same physical shape: within a category new sources add rows, not schema, and the shared groups and the registry are one set for every category (D-41; F-42). The timeframe group is the conformed calendar (Amendment R): one manifest for the whole star, so equal periods at equal grain are one row whichever category minted them.

Every *_values row carries the four-element pattern: value payload, manifest reference (schema key), record key, schema key. expert_context.category_limitations: Cancellation lines flow through retained-and-flagged; excluding them is a consumer decision, made at query time, never here. v1.0.0 deliberately reserved country; this version maps it, executing the signature test the reservation existed for.
expert_context.category_purpose: Declares how silver.silver_invoice_lines maps into the unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category. Consumed by the auto-modeling engine (D-07), which emits the gold dbt models; no physical table ever carries this contract's name.
expert_context.category_usage: Engine input only. Gate 1 lints it; gate 3 skips it by design (F-12); the engine validates it against mapping-contract.schema.json and cross-checks every field against the silver contract.

country.meaning: Customer country as landed; the signature-test dimension, mapped at v1.1.0.
country.source_meaning: Customer country as landed (24 distinct at v0001).

customer_id.meaning: Customer identifier; null on guest checkouts.
customer_id.source_meaning: Customer identifier, cast DECIMAL(38,9) to INTEGER (integral min, max, and samples, 12346 to 18287 at v0001). Decision: the 0.29778 bronze null rate is retained as null (guest or unregistered checkouts), not dropped and not imputed.

invoice_id.meaning: Invoice number; C prefix marks a cancellation.
invoice_id.source_meaning: Invoice number, kept as text (identifiers are text; Session D rule). A leading C marks a cancellation invoice; see is_cancellation.

invoiced_at.meaning: Invoice timestamp; the declared time column.
invoiced_at.source_meaning: Invoice timestamp. Decision: strict cast from the VARCHAR landing ("YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"); an unparseable value fails the build loudly rather than becoming a silent null. On within-invoice clock-drift duplicates the earliest scan tick wins (min).

is_cancellation.meaning: Cancellation flag; exclusion is a consumer decision.
is_cancellation.source_meaning: True when invoice_id carries the C cancellation prefix. Decision: cancellations are retained and flagged, not dropped, so conservation arithmetic against bronze stays auditable; exclusion is a consumer decision made at the mapping contract, not silently here.

product_description.source_meaning: Product description, whitespace-trimmed. Null rate 0.005041 at profile v0001; nulls retained rather than imputed.

stock_code.source_meaning: Product code as landed, kept as text; alphanumeric suffixes and non-product adjustment codes (for example POST, M) occur.

expert_context.how_to_read: Read silver.silver_invoice_lines for line-level retail sales analysis. Cancellation lines are RETAINED and flagged (is_cancellation); consumers aggregating revenue must filter or net them deliberately. Zero-price lines are retained.
expert_context.limitations: Exact duplicate bronze rows (rate 0.011188 at profile v0001) are treated as capture artifacts and excluded, so identical legitimate re-scans are indistinguishable and also excluded; the residual grain is the distinct line. Rows identical in every business column except invoicedate are the same capture artifact seen across a register clock tick (one pair at v0001, invoice 492807, one minute apart); they collapse to one line and the earliest timestamp is retained. customer_id is null on 29.778% of bronze rows at v0001 (guest or unregistered checkouts); those rows are retained with customer_id null.
